answer: Each hide is branded at the tannery gate, and the brand must match the tanner's own iron before the hide is sold. A horizon hide from another tannery fails the brand: at the sable of the leather the mark must match the gate book's iron, and a strange hide bears another mark. Forging hides means buying a tannery, tanning leather for a year and paying 15,900, and the mirror book at the gate is kept for ten years, so a hide whose brand belongs to no tanner is thrown out.
